This repository is `tripforge`, a keyless trip-planning CLI. Follow `AGENTS.md` for conventions. When the user asks for a trip plan, act as described in `agents/PLANNER_PROMPT.md`: minimal input, options menu first, frugal without compromising experience, every price tagged live or est, never invented, always a PDF deliverable, never book anything. Run the tool with `tripforge plan ...` and read `trips/<slug>/out/plan.json` for structured results.
